assessment.currency: The global11.9and9figures match Gavi US-dollar totals, not euro figures. Council independently reports approximatelyEUR10.2bn targeted andEUR7.7bn secured, so an alternative literal-euro interpretation is not supported. Do not substitute a newly calculated exchange rate.
assessment.context: Author physical12 expressly requests GermanyEUR750m across five years,150m annually, after noting its existing600m pledge and draft80m. This is an explicit request, but no formula derives it from the global gap.
assessment.materiality: Minor auxiliary unit mistake. Correcting both currencies leaves relative coverage broadly unchanged and confirms a substantial funding shortfall. It does not prove the requested German amount excessive or unnecessary.
assessment.direction: Null is appropriate. A reduced euro global gap could weaken an absolute scarcity comparison, but a corrected larger German share might instead strengthen the existing contribution portrayal; no mechanical allocation rule appears.

A different January24-page registration cannot supply that provenance. Author publication on the exact bill is useful but does not resolve the task-channel gate.
assessment.benign_alternative: Editorial currency replacement is plausible and limits argumentative consequences; it does not make the labelled units correct. No intent inferred.
